report.summary: payments-api experienced a ~3x increase in p99 latency starting at 13:20 on 2026-10-15 due to downstream latency propagation from ledger-service and ledger-db. The root cause was configuration change chg-8940 at 13:18, which increased the ledger query batch size from 100 to 1000, causing larger database operations, CPU spikes, and slower query responses starting at 13:19.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Ledger query batch size configuration change caused latency

supporting.note: Configuration change modifying query batch size directly precedes the database and service latency increase.
ledger-service p99 latency increased immediately following the configuration change.
ledger-db p99 latency increased at the same time.
ledger-service logged slow ledger queries starting at 13:19.
ledger-db logged slow statements starting at 13:19.
payments-api latency spiked right after downstream ledger latency increased.
Synchronous dependency links payments-api performance directly to ledger-service.

contradicting.note: Error rate and request rate remained stable, indicating successful completion rather than failure or timeouts.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Third-party UPI gateway or partner bank latency

supporting.note: p99 latency increase matches external gateway slowness symptoms.

contradicting.note: An internal config change occurred precisely before onset, making internal config regression much more probable.
ledger-service also degraded at the exact same time, aligning with the internal config change.

facts.text: payments-api p99 latency rose from a baseline of ~370-395 ms to 1252.38 ms at 2026-10-15T13:20:00+00:00, peaking at 1485.07 ms.
payments-api request rate and error rate remained stable with no significant anomalies during the incident window.
payments-api has synchronous dependencies on ledger-service, upi-gateway, fraud-service, and redis-cache, and an asynchronous dependency on event-bus.
A configuration change chg-8940 occurred on ledger-service at 2026-10-15T13:18:00+00:00 modifying the query batch size from 100 to 1000.
ledger-service p99 latency increased starting at 2026-10-15T13:19:00+00:00, with baseline 121.05 ms and peak 975.46 ms.
ledger-service began logging slow ledger queries starting at 2026-10-15T13:19:22+00:00.
ledger-db p99 latency increased starting at 2026-10-15T13:19:00+00:00, moving from a baseline of 14.77 ms to a peak of 138.58 ms.
ledger-db CPU usage increased starting at 2026-10-15T13:19:00+00:00, peaking at 52.86%.
ledger-db logged slow SQL statements starting at 2026-10-15T13:19:06+00:00.

assumptions: Synchronous calls from payments-api wait for ledger-service transactions to complete, causing request duration to track the increased database and ledger-service latency.

timeline.event: Configuration change chg-8940 increases ledger query batch size from 100 to 1000 on ledger-service.
ledger-service and ledger-db p99 latency metrics begin to increase; ledger-db CPU usage rises.
payments-api p99 latency increases significantly (onset of reported symptoms).

recommended_actions.action: Roll back configuration change chg-8940 on ledger-service to revert the query batch size from 1000 back to 100.
recommended_actions.rationale: Reverting the configuration change directly eliminates the root cause of the increased database load and latency propagation.

recommended_actions.action: Monitor ledger-service, ledger-db, and payments-api p99 latency metrics to confirm recovery after rollback.
recommended_actions.rationale: Ensures that latency returns to established baseline levels following remediation.

recommended_actions.action: Implement pre-deployment query performance and batch size impact testing for database-interacting configurations.
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents similar query size configuration regressions from impacting downstream synchronous clients in the future.
